description: Publish to one of the organization's connected social accounts (by channel id from neuron_list_social_channels). Text and/or up to 10 media items (several items make an Instagram carousel). Set as='story' to publish one image or video as an Instagram story (Instagram accounts connected with Instagram login; stories don't show a caption). Media URLs must be publicly reachable; Instagram images must be JPEG.
name: neuron_post_to_social_channel
title: Post to Social Channel
